concept.title: What Are Cookies
concept.shortdesc: Google uses cookies for functionality, security, advertising, advertising, and personalization.

section.context: NC State uses a variety of Google products on campus, including every student’s official NC State email address. Google collects and uses cookies when you use their products in several different ways.
section.p: Functionality: Deliver and maintain Google services Remembering choices and preferences Staying in your set language Storing information relating to your session (e.g. the items in your shopping cart) Enabling features or performing tasks you requested Product optimizations that help maintain and improve that service Security: Protect you as you interact with a service Authenticating users Protecting against spam, fraud, and abuse Tracking outages Analytics: Understand how you interact with a particular service. Measure audience engagement and site statistics Advertising: Serve, render, and personalize ads Limit the number of times an ad is shown to a user Muting ads you have chosen to stop seeing Delivering and measuring the effectiveness of ads Personalization: Show you personalized content Providing personalized content and features according to user settings Relevant results and recommendations Customizing YouTube homepage Ads tailored to your interests

Note: Even if you reject cookies and similar technologies used for personalization, you may continue to see personalized ads using other identifiers unless you turn off personalized ads. In addition, the non-personalized content and features you see may still be influenced by contextual factors, like your location, language, device type, or the content you’re currently viewing.
